name: M3_PPS200MI_LstLine2
description: List purchase order lines for a specific purchase order and return the full-length item and text fields for each line. The operation outputs the complete item name, the purchase order–specific item name, and the purchase order–specific item description, avoiding the truncation that applies in the standard list of purchase order lines. In addition to these texts, it returns basic line identity, configuration and kit control, date and planning data, pricing and reservation method, completion and charge flags, and key project, geographical, origin, and tax information. It is designed as a complement to the more detailed quantitative line listing.

inputParameters.name: PUNO
inputParameters.description: Purchase order number whose lines are listed in this transaction.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number used to select the purchase order; defaults to the logged-in company.

outputParameters.name: CONO
outputParameters.description: Company number that owns the purchase order.

outputParameters.name: PUNO
outputParameters.description: Purchase order number for which lines are displayed.

outputParameters.name: PNLI
outputParameters.description: Purchase order line number identifying the line being listed.

outputParameters.name: PNLS
outputParameters.description: Purchase order line suffix identifying a specific split or subline of the line.

outputParameters.name: CFIN
outputParameters.description: Configuration number identifying the item configuration used for this purchase order line.

outputParameters.name: FSCD
outputParameters.description: Kit control setting indicating whether the kit structure for this line is fixed or can be modified.

outputParameters.name: DT4T
outputParameters.description: Date type controlling which key date, such as requested delivery or planned put-away, applies to this line.

outputParameters.name: PLDT
outputParameters.description: Date when this purchase order line affects material planning.

outputParameters.name: PSET
outputParameters.description: Pricing method that defines how kit prices are calculated and distributed across component lines for this order line.

outputParameters.name: SRCD
outputParameters.description: Reservation level indicating whether inventory is reserved at kit level or component level for this line.

outputParameters.name: OEND
outputParameters.description: Indicator showing whether the purchase order line is flagged as fully completed with no remaining quantity to receive.

outputParameters.name: INEP
outputParameters.description: Total internal charges allocated to this purchase order line, excluding line-unique charges.

outputParameters.name: EXEP
outputParameters.description: Total external charges allocated to this purchase order line, excluding line-unique charges.

outputParameters.name: GTNF
outputParameters.description: Flag indicating whether GT Nexus processing for this purchase order line is completed.

outputParameters.name: ITDS
outputParameters.description: Full-length item name for the ordered item on the purchase order line.

outputParameters.name: PITD
outputParameters.description: Full-length item name as printed on the purchase order line.

outputParameters.name: PITT
outputParameters.description: Full-length extended item description as printed on the purchase order line.

outputParameters.name: GEOC
outputParameters.description: Geographical code used for tax calculation on this purchase order line.

outputParameters.name: ETRF
outputParameters.description: Reference code for standard external text to print on this purchase order line.

outputParameters.name: PROJ
outputParameters.description: Project number that this purchase order line is linked to.

outputParameters.name: ELNO
outputParameters.description: Project element within the linked project that this purchase order line is associated with.

outputParameters.name: ORCO
outputParameters.description: Country of origin for the item on this purchase order line.

outputParameters.name: TAXC
outputParameters.description: Tax code indicating whether this purchase order line is taxable for sales tax calculations.
